abstract: Ultrasound is an established method of confirming the presence of a hydatidiform mole in utero. However, in agreement with other investigations, we have often noted that the appearance of this entity is less specific than originally reported. To elucidate this, the ultrasonic patterns of 26 patients with trophoblastic disease and 27 with other entities were reviewed. Since there is a paucity of literature with regard to the response of choriocarcinoma to chemotherapy, determined by ultrasound, we simultaneously studied the relationship between findings of the ultrasonograms and the levels of hCG-beta-subunit in sera. We noted variable ultrasonic features in trophoblastic disease, and the sonograms of the choriocarcinoma have occasionally been confused with those of hydatidiform mole. If special attention is directed to the thickness of the placenta-like echoes as well as the sonolucent areas within it, the diagnosis of partial hydatidiform mole may be feasible. We also noted a rough correlation between ultrasonic appearances and the hCG-beta-subunit value, determined during chemotherapy for choriocarcinoma.
abstract_ja: 超音波検査は、子宮内の胞状奇胎の確認に確立された方法である。しかし、この所見の特異性は当初報告されたほど高くないことを、我々は繰り返し経験してきた。これを明らかにするため、絨毛性疾患26例と他の疾患27例の超音波所見を検討した。絨毛癌の化学療法への反応を超音波で評価した文献は乏しいため、超音波所見と血清中のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)βサブユニット値との関係も同時に検討した。絨毛性疾患の超音波所見は多様であり、絨毛癌の超音波像が胞状奇胎と混同されることがあった。胎盤様エコーの厚さおよびその内部の無エコー領域に注意を払えば、部分胞状奇胎の診断が可能になるかもしれない。また、絨毛癌の化学療法中に測定したhCGβサブユニット値と超音波所見との間には、おおまかな相関が認められた。
